authority: apostila-cga-2026; adversarial review round 2, gap R4
method: the 132 suppressed spans enumerated by scripts/report_recall.py, read one by one, then every wrong pattern counted against the form's total
reason: A method error, not a data error. Demotion was applied to every ambiguous form regardless of HOW wrong it was, because the campaign optimised precision with no recall floor. `rendimento` was wrong in 5 of 30 and demoting it cost roughly 25 correct matches to avoid 5 wrong ones. Where the wrong uses are few and enumerable, forbidding them and keeping the form automatic dominates demotion on both metrics.

operations.why: Restoring what the ungoverned demotion destroyed. The suppressed-span list shows `Yield to Worst: É o rendimento no pior cenário`, `deduzindo o rendimento de um instrumento do outro` and `a diferença entre o rendimento de um título e o rendimento de uma taxa de referência` all going silent — the financial sense, in the chapter that defines it. Only the tax-chapter uses are wrong and they share two collocations, forbidden below.
The five wrong occurrences: `a operação que deu origem ao rendimento para o cotista` and `alíquota de curto prazo para o rendimento produzido` are taxable income, not yield.
1 of 6 wrong. `em troca de um desconto`, `comprando com desconto` and `DESÁGIO (desconto)` are the financial sense and were all silenced.
The single wrong occurrence: `resulte em desconto, abatimento ou redução de taxa de administração` is a fee rebate.
2 of 10 wrong, both adjectival and both with a fixed collocation. `contratos de swap, futuros, e opções` and `futuros ou termos de moeda` are the instrument and were silenced.
All four adjectival uses in the corpus.
`Opções de taxa de juros`, `as opções podem entrar no dinheiro` and `swap, futuros e opções` are the instrument. The alternative sense has two fixed shapes, forbidden below.
`exercer a opção`, `as condições acordadas na opção`, `preço do derivativo Opção` are the instrument.
`São uma boa opção para proteger` and `entre duas opções, devemos escolher` are the everyday `alternative`, four and one occurrences. `A opção por um dos critérios` is a choice of accounting method.
